value.rationale: Subdivided stars are the canonical one-branching extension of paths, and stabilization depth is a standard logical and graph-isomorphism complexity measure. The exact formula separates two mechanisms and shows a sharp discontinuity from the equilateral case to a single exceptional arm, while the all-round descriptor is reusable.
